page_title: ROM 3-3 JUV | AS Roma v Juventus 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' 3 - 3 Goal! Federico Gatti (Juventus) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 3:3.
90+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) takes it short.

90+1' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Pellegrini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma).
89' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lois Openda (Juventus) replacing Andrea Cambiaso.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Gatti (Juventus) replaces Bremer.
87' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

87' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
85' Donyell Malen receives a sweet cross inside the box from Zeki Celik (AS Roma), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
83' Simone Sozza blows his whistle after Fabio Miretti (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
80' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
78' 3 - 2 Goal! Jeremie Boga (Juventus) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
76' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Lloyd Kelly (Juventus).
74' The referee signals a substitution. Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Devyne Rensch.
74' That will be all from Bryan Cristante who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
72' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) replaces Khephren Thuram.
72' Substitution. Francisco Conceicao makes his way off the pitch and Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
71' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
69' Mile Svilar blocks Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus)'s effort from the edge of the box.
67' 10:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
65' 3 - 1 Goal! Manu Kone gets to the ball, slips Donyell Malen (AS Roma) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:1.
64' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
63' Jonathan David comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremie Boga (Juventus).
62' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempts to find Weston McKennie with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
60' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
56' 49:51 – the ratio of ball possession.

54' 2 - 1 Lorenzo Pellegrini sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:1.
54' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
53' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
51' Mile Svilar displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
49' Some patient build-up play from Juventus as they look to unlock the defence.

47' 1 - 1 Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:1.
46' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Jonathan David (Juventus) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
43' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
41' Corner kicks – 2:0.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Niccolo Pisilli slips it to Wesley Franca (AS Roma) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.
39' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
39' Corner kick. Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is ready to send the ball into the box.
37' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
35' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
34' Weston McKennie (Juventus) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
32' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
31' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
29' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:2.
27' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
26' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

24' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Donyell Malen (AS Roma) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Mattia Perin pulls off an easy save.
23' Jonathan David (Juventus) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
22' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
17' AS Roma hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
15' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 38:62.
13' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
12' Wasted opportunity! Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
10' Juventus players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
6' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends a long ball in, but Mile Svilar comfortably gathers the ball.
4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!

3' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Mattia Perin allowed him to make a comfortable save.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
